mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the recording of transactions i.e the record making phase of accounting."
Book-keeping is the recording of transactions i.e the record making phase of accounting.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a summary of the timing and flow of Naira in and out of the farm business."
The cash flow statement is a summary of the timing and flow of Naira in and out of the farm business.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the principal book of accounts."
The ledger is the principal book of accounts.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the only program listed due to its widespread use across the United States of America."
Quicken is the only program listed due to its widespread use across the United States of America.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the accounting term indicating the difference between the two sides of an account."
The balance is the accounting term indicating the difference between the two sides of an account.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the third segment of the conventional Trading, Profit and Loss Account."
The Profit and Loss Appropriation Account is the third segment of the conventional Trading, Profit and Loss Account.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used for the purpose of recording transactions, which because of their nature cannot be entered in any other book of prime entry."
The Journal Proper The journal or Journal proper is used for the purpose of recording transactions, which because of their nature cannot be entered in any other book of prime entry.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used as collateral for a loan."
often are used as collateral for a loan.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an account into which all gains and losses are collected."
The profit and Loss Account is an account into which all gains and losses are collected.

______ is the value of all assets on the farm less the amount of money owed against those assets.
networth
The networth is the value of all assets on the farm less the amount of money owed against those assets.

income statement
The income statement is used to calculate net cash income, adjusted by changes in inventories and capital items.
______ refers to the 'bottom line' profit that is earned (or projected to earn) by the business during the accounting period.
Net farm income
The Net farm income refers to the 'bottom line' profit that is earned (or projected to earn) by the business during the accounting period.
______ are used to describe soil conditions cropping patterns, field layouts and building locations.
Farm maps
Farm maps are used to describe soil conditions cropping patterns, field layouts and building locations.
______ is responsible for ensuring all transactions are recorded in the correct day book, suppliers ledger, customer ledger and general ledger.
bookkeeper
The bookkeeper is responsible for ensuring all transactions are recorded in the correct day book, suppliers ledger, customer ledger and general ledger.

Inventory change
Inventory change is a critical element if quantities are to coincide with accrual adjusted financial measures.
______ is a list of balances both credit and debit extracted from the ledgers and cash book of a company as at a particular date.
trial balance
A trial balance is a list of balances both credit and debit extracted from the ledgers and cash book of a company as at a particular date.
